notes.title: Version 1.3 | Small Bugfixes
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

I wanna start off by thanking everyone for the feedback they've left for the game! It helps me to see what bugs need fixing and it makes my job way way easier!

This update is rather small, and I've fixed/added some minor things:

Fixes:

- Fixed and issue where the keybding for restarting couldn't be changed

New Stuff:

- Added a new line of dialogue at one of the earlier puzzles, to make it easier for the player to understand that they can grab plants
- Added a new text in the main menu that appears when you press the turbo button, making it easier to tell when it's active.

Also, we've reached [b]almost 7000 plays[/b], hurray!

This is all for the most part, thank you everybody! Enjoy this weekend!

-Alex

notes.title: Version 1.2.5 | Keybind Options
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Everyone![/h1]

It's been some time since I've lasted posted an update related to the game here, so let's begin!

I wanna start off by thanking everyone for the reception of the game! Reading the reviews has been so fun, and seeing that [b]~4000[/b] people played my game feels surreal!

[h2]What's new![/h2]

There aren't major changes in this update, just one small thing that has been bugging me for some time has been fixed, and that being the [b]keybindings menu has been added in your phone[/b], this way you can change the keybinding to your liking without having to go to the main menu, hurray!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43648080/1b338a07ea105af7e409fbd984b523da1aee7e8a.png[/img]

This is basically the whole update! For now, I'll keep reading the reviews and the feedback people will send me, and I'll try to fix any pesky bugs that people will find!

See ya around!

-Alex

notes.title: Version 1.2 | Minor Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Hello!

I want to start by thanking everyone that had a blast playing my small puzzle game, it means a lot to see so many of you liked my little passion project!

This patch is rather small, I've mostly fixed 2 issues I've seen people have encountered so far:

- fixed the problem where platforms could push you under the map, now they [b]instantly kill you instead[/b]

- fixed an issue where some areas would look weird for widescreen users.

If you encounter any bugs, please mention them in a community post, and I'll try to fix them as soon as possible!

Have a great weekend everyone!

-Alex
